prompt: I have a complex full-stack application with a Python Flask API backend serving user data and a React frontend that displays it in a dashboard. The backend runs on port 8080 and frontend on port 3000. I need you to write an automated test that verifies the complete user workflow: 1) Navigate to the dashboard, 2) Wait for the user list to load from the API, 3) Click on the 'Add User' button, 4) Fill out the form with name 'John Doe' and email 'john@example.com', 5) Submit the form, 6) Verify the new user appears in the list, and 7) Take a screenshot of the final state. The test should also capture any console errors and verify the API calls are working correctly. Make it robust - sometimes the API takes a few seconds to respond.
